## Stereoscopic 3D: per-layer depth

### Features
- **Per-layer 3D depth**: BG1-BG4 and Sprites each get a depth gauge (-8..+8; positive pops out of the screen, negative sinks in), configured per game in the new Stereoscopic 3D menu section.
- Depth settings live in shareable text files at `sd:/3ds/snes9x_3ds/stereo3d/<game>.3d` (fallback `default.3d`).
- Stereo architecture: both eyes render into retained per-eye textures and composite every frame - stable on real hardware at full speed.

### Fixes
- Per-layer parallax no longer sticks on the first background's value (uniform push between layer draws).
